notes.title: Union of Gnomes is out in Early Access!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/]Union of Gnomes[/url] is out in Early Access! A warband of gnomes is ready to stand up against Snow White's tyranny and storm the Gnomontanomo to end gnome trafficking and stop their brothers' oppression! We are waiting only for you, the bold leader of the gnome movement for freedom, equality, and the right to be a gnome in any situation. 

[previewyoutube=hUkMF_3Lw0s;full][/previewyoutube]

Discover the dark side of characters from your favorite fairy tales, fight them in tense battles, and make the most of your squad's abilities and talents. Combine different cards and create unusual and spectacular combos to defeat the enemy with minimal losses.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/

Below, you can check out our plans for the game's Early Access phase.

[h2][b]Early Access: [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] 2 acts of six;
[*] 5 story missions;
[*] 3 story adventures with bosses;
[*] 29 quests;
[*] 28 common enemies;
[*] 8 bosses;
[*] 2 heroes with unique features and talents;
[*] 18 hero talents;
[*] 97 gnome cards;
[*] And 1 very special Neverending Nightmare Mode.
[/list]
[h2][b]ACT III Let’s bust the propaganda nest![/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] New Bosses: The Wizard of Oz, Couturier Knonoff
[*] New Enemies and Quests
[*] MORE GNOMES!
[/list]
[h2][b]ACT IV The Road To University.[/b][/h2]
Seekings of a Snow White’s Secret
[list]
[*] New enemies and strange creatures: Sirin, Alkonost, and Black Goat.
[*] And, sure thing, new recruits to the gnomes' posse!
[/list]
[h2][b]New hero - Commander![/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Quality of Life improvements 
[*] New heroes’ talents!
[*] Definitely new gnomes!
[/list]
[h2][b]The Circles of Madness[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Update for a Neverending Nightmare Mode!
[*] Does the Candle still burn?
[/list]
[h2][b]Act V The Kings' Cesspool - Smelly Fatport[/b][/h2]
The smugglers’, pirates' and the mermaid's hideout
[list]
[*] Will you be the same after facing the mermaid?? 
[*] Also introducing Ali Baba, who surely won't show his coins!
[/list]
[h2][b]Full Release, Pu-pu-ru-pu! Totally Finalish Finale! MEET THE SNOW WHITE![/b][/h2]
Agenda:
[list]
[*] Сorrupt liar judge, Naked King!
[*] Сastle party, networking amusements, monsters, and quests! 
[*] And, as tradition demands, new gnomes!
[/list]
At all stages of development, we are eager for your feedback, bug reports, ideas for game development, and anything else you wish to share with the Union of Gnomes team.

Meanwhile... let's go! Let's overthrow Snow White and free the gnomes from years of slavery! 

Freedom to Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Free prologue with new boss and secret mission!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades!

We are excited to present the new and mysterious prologue version of Union of Gnomes. It combines the creepy atmosphere of dark fantasy, cheerful humor, and, of course, the daring gnomes desperately fighting for their freedom and independence. 
 
[previewyoutube=atZ26XQlAEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Lead a motley crew of guerrillas to free your captured comrades and escape the tyranny of the ruthless Snow White. For the tenacious players, we've hidden a secret quest within the prologue—conquering it will bring you closer to solving the mystery of the eighth gnome! Look for the clue in the video!

Here's what you'll find in the game:
[list]
[*] One new, unique and terribly dangerous mission!
[*] A dangerous new boss!
[*] A secret quest!
[*] A lot of well-known – and not so well-known – fairy tale characters who fight on the side of evil, trying to suppress and destroy the gnomes!
[*] Create unusual combos with your gnome cards to reach the end of the prologue or die with honor!
[/list]
Once you've finished the prologue (and added Union of Gnomes to your Steam Wishlist), you can look forward to the full story of the gnomes' heroic adventures as they fight for their freedom in the full game. The gnomes stand for freedom and the right not to impose subjugation on anyone else!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/ 

Don't forget to recommend the game to your friends and favorite streamers, share your impressions, and leave a review. 

Freedom to Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team
